Question: As you aware better the situation of Afghanistan Here in Afghanistan i am working with Afghan government as an Official. but our scholars says that working with current government is prohibited in Islam but some of the scholars says that no problem you can work with government please advice me that what is islam says about this. Thanks. Answer ID: 9213 Posted on: Aug 31, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1224/1224=M/1429) You should follow the ulama who, according to you, are more pious, righteous and those authorised to give fatwa. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
